title: Edit Distance
prompt:
Return the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions, or replacements to convert `word1` into `word2`.

**Example**: `"horse" → "ros"` → `3`.

The canonical 2-D DP: dp[i][j] = edit distance between the first i chars of word1 and first j of word2.
hints: Base cases: converting to/from an empty string costs its length (dp[i][0] = i, dp[0][j] = j).
If the current chars match, dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] (no edit).
Otherwise 1 + min of replace (dp[i-1][j-1]), delete (dp[i-1][j]), insert (dp[i][j-1]).

solution.explanation: Each cell asks how to align two prefixes: matching chars cost nothing (diagonal), otherwise pick the cheapest of the three edits — replace (diagonal), delete from word1 (up), insert into word1 (left). Row/column 0 encode the empty-string conversions. O(m·n).
